title: Add a --json flag to the CLI argument parser

brief.goal: Extend parseArgs in src/cli.ts so `--json` anywhere in argv sets `json: true` and is removed from `words`; unknown `--flags` throw an Error; render() prints `{"words":[...]}` when json is set.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: parseArgs(["--nope"]) throws an Error mentioning the flag
render({ json: false, words: ["a", "b"] }) returns "a b" as before

expected_clean_output: parseArgs handles --json in any position, rejects unknown flags; render emits JSON when asked.

seeded_defect.description: The flag is only recognised as the first argument; `a --json b` keeps "--json" as a word.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: parseArgs(["a", "--json", "b"]).json is false and words contain "--json".
